# 音色・音程を直接学習する比較試験 / 2026-11-13
# 末尾の今回専用セルのみ実行する。
from google.colab import files
acoustic_upload = files.upload()
run:
# 入力照合、隔離した追加ライブラリ、同条件の比較学習
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, io, json, os, subprocess, sys, zipfile
acoustic_blob = acoustic_upload['irodori-world-acoustic-input-20261113.zip']
assert hashlib.sha256(acoustic_blob).hexdigest() == '5bf78f4e2d3afade28c2bd2709607d5ce20a3232e3a0cffce967908ccda2d25b'
acoustic_root = Path('/content/sumi_world_acoustic_20261113')
acoustic_input = acoustic_root/'input'
acoustic_input.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(acoustic_blob)) as archive:
    assert all((acoustic_input/n).resolve().is_relative_to(acoustic_input.resolve()) for n in archive.namelist())
    archive.extractall(acoustic_input)
manifest = json.loads((acoustic_input/'SHA256.json').read_text())
for name, expected in manifest.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((acoustic_input/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name
print('INPUT_VERIFIED', len(manifest), flush=True)
acoustic_deps=acoustic_root/'deps'
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','--target',str(acoustic_deps),'--no-deps','pyworld==0.3.5','setuptools==80.9.0'],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=240)
(acoustic_root/'setup.log').write_text(r.stdout)
r.check_returncode()
acoustic_env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(acoustic_deps))
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(acoustic_input),'-p','test*world*.py','-v'],env=acoustic_env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=45)
(acoustic_root/'tests.log').write_text(r.stdout)
print(r.stdout[-1200:], flush=True)
r.check_returncode()
subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader'],check=True)
acoustic_log=acoustic_root/'training.log'
with acoustic_log.open('x') as log:
    acoustic_process=subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','720s',sys.executable,str(acoustic_input/'train_world_acoustic.py'),'--data',str(acoustic_input/'data'),'--base',str(acoustic_input/'base.pt'),'--output',str(acoustic_root/'output'),'--device','cuda','--steps','5000','--max-seconds','240'],env=acoustic_env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('TRAIN_STARTED', acoustic_process.pid, flush=True)
status:
# 今回の比較学習だけを監視する。
print('PROCESS',acoustic_process.poll())
print(acoustic_log.read_text()[-180:])
for condition in ('control','acoustic'):
    p=acoustic_root/'output'/condition/'completed.json'
    if p.exists():
        d=json.loads(p.read_text())
        print(condition,{k:d[k] for k in ('updates','best_step','best_validation_score','test_score','training_seconds')})
download:
# 結果を退避。Macで照合してからGPUを停止する。
assert acoustic_process.poll() == 0
assert (acoustic_root/'output/completed.json').exists()
acoustic_zip=Path('/content/sumi_world_acoustic_results_20261113.zip')
with zipfile.ZipFile(acoustic_zip,'x',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    for p in sorted(acoustic_root.rglob('*')):
        rel=p.relative_to(acoustic_root)
        if p.is_file() and rel.parts[0]!='deps' and '__pycache__' not in rel.parts and not (len(rel.parts)>1 and rel.parts[:2]==('input','data')):
            archive.write(p,str(rel))
print('RESULT_BYTES',acoustic_zip.stat().st_size,flush=True)
print('RESULT_SHA256',hashlib.sha256(acoustic_zip.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
files.download(str(acoustic_zip))
